Eight lines, exit 139. `__rt_stream_fd` answers -1 for a handle it cannot
resolve, which is what a closed stream gives; -1 has every bit set, so the
`tst x13, #0x40000000` that recognises a SYNTHETIC user-wrapper descriptor
matched it and handed -1 to `__rt_user_wrapper_stream_cast`, which dereferenced
it. A `-1` guard now runs first, in the build pass and the compact pass and on
both architectures — the two loops
